represented_source: FAR 2024/82, descriptive data and model input support report through 2023.
FAR 2024/83, stock-hypothesis report for the Sub-Antarctic ling unit.
Fisheries Assessment Plenary 2025, current assessment-status cross-check.
Fisheries Assessment Plenary May 2026, pp. 861 and 892: confirms LIN 5&6 and LIN 6B last assessed in 2024 and next scheduled for 2027.

FAR 2024/74, Tables 11 and 17: LIN 5&6 2023 trawl and longline calculated numbers-at-age; the 2024 assessment's age-composition series ends in 2022, so these later series are not imported as inputs to that run.
FAR 2024/85, observer-coverage analysis and sensitivity results; confirms bottom-longline age compositions were used but does not provide numeric age-composition likelihood vectors.
